description: Prepares a manual (custom) journal entry as a draft: the accounts to debit and credit, line by line, for adjustments, accruals, reclassifications and corrections. The debits must equal the credits. To copy or reverse a past entry, read it with journal_entries and send its lines (swap every debit and credit to reverse it). An entry that came from an invoice or a bill is better voided in the app: a reversing journal leaves the document open. It is created as a DRAFT: nothing is posted, paid or sent. Tell the user it is waiting for them in Mobile Accounting (openInApp).

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

currency.description: ISO currency when not the books' own.

description.description: What the entry is for (for example "Accrue December rent").

lines.description: The lines: each an account with a debit or a credit. At least two.

account.description: The account: its code (for example "1000") or its name, as account_balances or journal_entries show it.

categoryId.description: Or a category id from list_categories instead of an account (optional).

credit.description: The credit amount, positive (leave empty on a debit line).

debit.description: The debit amount, positive (leave empty on a credit line).

party.description: The person this line belongs to, by name (optional): an owner on an owner account (due to owners, owner's equity, drawings), or whoever lent or borrowed the money on a loans payable / receivable line. The line then posts to that person's own account.

notes.description: A note for the person who reviews it.

name: record_journal_entry
title: Record a journal entry (draft)
